description.m_value: 深池的“领袖”，焚烧生命的德拉克，一个令人恐惧的影子。不要被她困住。

nativeChain.operation: uses explosion entity gridPosition as box range origin

interpretation.fireDirectDamage: ordinary level0 ATK800; PRTS confirms 100% arts MELEE SPLASH, plus 125% FIRE EP. Death template direct actions have no projectile/delay wrapper; native direct ApplyModifier closes sync path.
interpretation.fireElementDamage: 800*1.25=1000, equal to normal operator burn threshold. A counterexample only isolating 800 arts must explicitly choose existing burn burst cooldown (or a qualified EP restriction); do not ignore the elemental follow-up.
interpretation.applicability: Fire is runtime summoned by boss Chain_1/Chain_2; level does not directly SPAWN it. An adjacent killer lies in x-5 and can attack it; the fire host itself is disarmed so do not position killer on its own tile.
interpretation.ordering: Combine native source OnTargetKilled(Event9) before victim OnDead(Event3), independently established in Case39, with flameb_t_1 maxHP additive STACK on Event9; fire OnDead applies synchronous damage. Moving source on-kill after full victim cleanup can change HP before fire damage.
